headline: Mooring Ledger Shifts as Other Fronts Ease
war_summary: Since the last edition, Mooring County has undergone the sharpest change in the ledger: its former nine-to-three Warden lead is now six Warden, five Colonial and one neutral, with seven recorded events in the latest two hours and 44 in 24. Linn Mercy has moved from nine Colonial, one Warden and one neutral to ten Colonial, none Warden and one neutral; 13 events fell in six hours, though none in the latest two. Weathered Expanse likewise shifts from five Warden, two Colonial and two neutral to four, three and two, with ten events in six hours but none in the latest two. Callum’s Cape remains four Colonial to three Warden; its 45-event 24-hour tally is high, but no events were recorded in two hours and just two in six. Marban Hollow’s three-three-two division persists, with no events in six hours. The unsettled fronts still warrant attention, but the immediate pulse is concentrated in Mooring County. The war remains undecided, with 34 victory towns required.
